bellows.notes: Connected boards, hinged handle, leather folds and tapered nozzle create a readable lateral gesture. Leather stays matte copper-brown against pale boards; identity holds at all three review sizes.

quench-trough.notes: Long trough and steel bar read clearly with continuous support. The narrow water slit and steam become subtle at 64x45, so retain for scene compositions rather than a small water-status icon.

anvil-block.notes: Long horn and broad heel sit on a fitted low masonry block. Cool iron and warm light planes are distinct; strongest single silhouette in this kit at compact size.

clamp-bench.notes: Open vise jaws attach to a braced wood bench. Main mechanism remains recognizable at 80x56; screw details simplify at 64x45. This is a visual prop concept, not a mechanically validated machine design.

crucible-stand.notes: Tilted ceramic bowl sits in a continuous two-sided iron support with a stable stone foot. Interior warm plane stays restrained; no unsupported molten splash or floating mount.

coal-hopper.notes: Wedge body, coal mass and open feed door remain distinct at compact size. Fitted feet and hinge are clear; ember accent is subordinate to the structural silhouette.

cooling-rack.notes: Open shelves, diagonal brace and two unequal ceramic molds remain clear at 160x112 and 80x56. Small slats simplify at 64x45; broad shelf gaps preserve identity.

vent-chimney.notes: Bent hood, continuous flue and warm recessed slit distinguish the vent from the other props. Quiet stone base supports the hood; no excessive smoke or ornament.
